value.text: Anonimo Gaddiano anecdote of a quarrel over Dante

claims.statement: The Anonimo Gaddiano tells of a quarrel at Santa Trinita over a passage of Dante, in which Michelangelo taunted Leonardo over the unfinished horse. This states what the text says; the event is undocumented.
